name: build-journey-architecture
example-prompts: Compile the application use cases and scaffold the architecture for every detected journey.
Run the graph that prepares the journey API architecture from the existing journey use cases.

instructions: Use global-designs as the run/<domain> name.
Capture the JSON object printed to stdout and preserve its journeys array for the next job.
Do not open or inspect the generated output artifact to obtain journey identifiers.
Use only the journey identifiers from the previous job stdout journeys array.
Pass every journey identifier to the script with a repeated --journey option.
Do not read a managed output file to discover or normalize journey identifiers.
